blocks.text: Sweepfold preserves a familiar household gesture: opening a cloth and clearing a surface. The compressed Era Four object joins that gesture to care, while its written instructions retain the exact limits of its use.
A folded cloth on a wooden clasp. Open, sweep, and release.
One-shot use: The cloth unrolls across its wooden holder, then releases a large circular wash of droplets, leaving the holder empty. The game performs the final fade.
9 silver. Infection severity −1; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Cleanliness +10; Health +2. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
